theorem: The characteristic-2 order-two obstruction is completely localized in the 316-dimensional C13-fixed sector. F2[V2] has 64 split trivial states plus 126 Jordan blocks, whereas hexagon homology has 158 Jordan blocks and no split trivial states. The W12^315 sector already has the unique compatible D26 semilinear extension. Hence the exact defect is 32 missing nonsplit extensions and admits the displayed minimal stable repair.
boundary: All counting and C2-module decompositions are exact from existing certificates. Uniqueness of the nontrivial D26 extension uses standard nonabelian Hilbert 90 for GL_315(F_{2^12}) under the degree-two fixed-field involution.
